notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
New Mount Available: Ride into adventure with our latest mount, designed to enhance your exploration and travel experience.

New Weapons: Discover powerful weapons with unique abilities to suit a variety of playstyles.

New Skills: Master brand-new abilities that add depth and strategy to combat, giving you more ways to dominate the battlefield.

notes.title: Details of the July 9 Update
notes.content: The Black Pyramid Dungeon has been opened.

notes.title: Beware — the Black Knight is near!
notes.content: The Black Knight boss has arrived — who’s brave enough to face him?

notes.title: Mysterious Installation: Zahim's Base
notes.content: Discover a new secret base. The Sand Nomads guard ancient mysteries. Find Zahim, the enigmatic NPC.

notes.title: Beyond the Winter: Desert Awakens
notes.content:
New desert map: A new region has been added, expanding the world for exploration.

New NPCs: New characters have been introduced, offering unique interactions and deeper storylines.

New missions: Additional quests are now available, featuring exclusive rewards.

Winter transition: It is now possible to move beyond the winter season and experience a new climate cycle.
